title: Telehealth continues to widen access to speech-language therapy for autistic children
summary: Telepractice delivery of speech-language therapy has continued to grow, particularly for families in rural or underserved areas facing long waitlists for in-person specialists. Reviews of the research suggest telehealth can produce clinical outcomes comparable to in-person sessions for many children, though hybrid models combining remote and in-person visits remain common where feasible.
